title: 类属性
instruction:
定义 Dog 类，添加类属性 species = "Canis familiaris"。

创建两个 Dog 对象，输出它们的 species。

类属性对所有实例共享。
hint: 类属性定义在方法外面
starter:
class Dog:
    # 请在下面定义类属性
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name

dog1 = Dog("Buddy")
dog2 = Dog("Max")
print(dog1.species)
print(dog2.species)
answer:
class Dog:
    species = "Canis familiaris"
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name

dog1 = Dog("Buddy")
dog2 = Dog("Max")
print(dog1.species)
print(dog2.species)
encouragement: 类属性被所有实例共享！
